20%20%20%23%23%23%23%20Tips%20to%20set%20a%20threshold%20for%20detecting%20transition%3A%20here%20you%20can%20see%20the%20pixel%20values%20first%20fluctuated%20390000%20and%20420000%2C%20and%20then%20split%20into%20two%20phases%2C%20one%20of%20them%20seems%20to%20fluctuate%20between%20420000%20and%20440000%3B%20the%20other%20one%20seeems%20to%20fluctuate%20between%20380000%20and%20400000.%20The%20frist%20fluctuation%20comes%20from%20the%20first%20300%20second%20stimulus%20interval%20(no-dot%20grey%20screen).%20The%20two%20phases%20come%20from%20reading%20synchorisation%20patch%20on%20the%20LED%20panel%20turning%20between%20white%20(RGB%20value%3A1%2C1%2C1)%20and%20black%20(RGB%20value%3A0%2C0%2C0).%20However%2C%20even%20within%20one%20phase%2C%20the%20readouts%20flucate%20and%20stay%20stable%20from%20time%20to%20time%20(for%20example%20between%20frame%20100000%20and%20frame%20150000%20looks%20much%20stable%20than%20other%20time%20points).%20This%20is%20what%20I%20meant%20the%20signal%20to%20noise%20ratio%20is%20low%20if%20you%20directly%20read%20the%20pixel%20values%20from%20a%20synchronisation%20path%20in%20the%20Bonsai%20workflow%20%5BReadme%5D(https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fchiyu1203%2Fbonvision_rdk%2Ftree%2Fmain%2FBonsaiWorkflows).%20The%20stable%20line%20probably%20came%20from%20the%20time%20when%20the%20animal%20did%20not%20move%20at%20all.%0A%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%23%20The%20good%20news%20is%20that%20as%20long%20as%20you%20can%20see%20the%20seperate%20into%20two%20phases%20after%20the%205-min%20grey%20screen%2C%20it%20is%20quite%20possible%20that%20you%20can%20seperate%20them%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(analysis_methods)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%23Since%20we%20know%20how%20long%20is%20the%20grey%20screen%2C%20we%20can%20ignore%20those%20readouts%20based%20on%20time%20and%20then%20focus%20on%20converting%20readings%20from%20the%20two%20phases%20into%20transition%20from%20the%20LED%20on-to-off%20phase%20and%20from%20the%20off-to-on%20phase%0A%20%20%20%20pre_stim_grey_screen%3Danalysis_methods.get(%22prestim_duration%22)%0A%20%20%20%20%23Setting%20an%20arbitrary%20threshold%20to%20split%20the%20two%20phase%0A%20%20%20%20transition_threshold%3D410000%0A%20%20%20%20%23to%20prevent%20noisy%20signals%20from%20crossing%20the%20threshold%20(false%20positive%20detection)%2C%20we%20can%20specify%20minimal%20duration%20for%20each%20phase%20based%20on%20how%20long%20the%20inter-stimulus-interval%20and%20stimulus%20presentation%20were%20designed%20in%20the%20experiment%0A%20%20%20%20_min_stim%3Danalysis_methods.get(%22stim_duration%22)%0A%20%20%20%20_min_interval%3Dmin(analysis_methods.get(%22interval_duration%22))%0A%20%20%20%20min_phase_duration%3D%5B_min_stim%2C_min_interval%5D%0A%20%20%20%20return%20min_phase_duration%2C%20pre_stim_grey_screen%2C%20transition_threshold%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(%0A%20%20%20%20camera_fps%2C%0A%20%20%20%20led_values%2C%0A%20%20%20%20min_phase_duration%2C%0A%20%20%20%20np%2C%0A%20%20%20%20pre_stim_grey_screen%2C%0A%20%20%20%20transition_threshold%2C%0A)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20_pass_threshold%20%3D%20led_values%20%3E%20transition_threshold%0A%20%20%20%20_pass_threshold_index%20%3D%20np.where(_pass_threshold)%5B0%5D%0A%20%20%20%20%23up_phase%20%3D%20np.append(_pass_threshold_index%5B0%5D%2C_pass_threshold_index%5B1%3A%5D%5B%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20np.diff(_pass_threshold_index)%20%3E%20min_phase_duration%5B0%5D%20*%200.6%20*%20%23camera_fps%5D)%0A%20%20%20%20up_phase%3D_pass_threshold_index%5B1%3A%5D%5Bnp.diff(_pass_threshold_index)%20%3E%20min_phase_duration%5B0%5D%20*%200.6%20*%20camera_fps%5D%0A%20%20%20%20b2w%20%3D%20up_phase%5Bup_phase%20%3E%20camera_fps%20*%20pre_stim_grey_screen%5D%0A%0A%20%20%20%20_pass_threshold%20%3D%20transition_threshold%20%3E%20led_values%0A%20%20%20%20_pass_threshold_index%20%3D%20np.where(_pass_threshold)%5B0%5D%0A%20%20%20%20down_phase%20%3D%20_pass_threshold_index%5B1%3A%5D%5Bnp.diff(_pass_threshold_index)%20%3E%20min_phase_duration%5B1%5D%20*%200.6%20*camera_fps%5D%0A%20%20%20%20w2b%20%3D%20down_phase%5Bdown_phase%20%3E%20camera_fps%20*%20pre_stim_grey_screen%5D%23%20remove%20transition%20during%20pre-stim%20grey%20screen%0A%20%20%20%20%23Here%20you%20will%20notice%20that%20there%20is%20one%20more%20event%20logged%20for%20b2w%20than%20for%20w2b.%20That%20event%20came%20from%20an%20additional%20transition%20during%20which%20the%20last%20stimulus%20was%20delivered%20(the%20screen%20switch%20bacn%20to%20grey%20screen)%0A%20%20%20%20return%20(w2b%2C)%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(stim_info%2C%20w2b)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20_num_stimulus%3Dint(stim_info.shape%5B0%5D%2F2)%0A%20%20%20%20stim_to_analyse%3Dw2b%5B%3A_num_stimulus%5D%2B1%23%20When%20the%20transition%20happens%20on%20the%20Nth%20frame%2C%20you%20can%20say%20the%20stimulus%20also%20starts%20from%20Nth%20frame%2C%20but%20I%20would%20prefer%20to%20define%20it%20as%20N%2B1th%20frame.%20Note%3A%20when%20temporal%20accuracy%20is%20required%2C%20you%20would%20probably%20needs%20to%20set%20two%20thresholds%20for%20detecting%20transitions.%20One%20of%20them%20closer%20to%20the%20LED%20on%20phase%20and%20the%20other%20one%20closer%20to%20the%20LED%20off%20phase.%20In%20this%20design%2C%20you%20can%20capture%20the%20exact%20time%20when%20the%20value%20starts%20to%20cross%20thresholds%20(of%20leaving%20a%20phase%20and%20of%20entering%20another%20phase).%0A%20%20%20%20return%20(stim_to_analyse%2C)%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23Session%204.3%3A%20align%20data%20with%20event%20timing.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%23Session%204.3.1%3A%20Use%20the%20timing%20of%20events%20from%204.1%20session%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(%0A%20%20%20%20analysis_methods%2C%0A%20%20%20%20camera_fps% _df%5B%22Path%22%5D.str.contains(animal_ID)%5D%0A%20%20%20%20init_frame%3Dabs(analysis_window%5B0%5D)*camera_fps%0A%20%20%20%20end_frame%3D(abs(analysis_window%5B0%5D)%2Banalysis_window%5B1%5D)*camera_fps%0A%20%20%20%20_fig%2C_fig_tbt%3Dplot_yaw_angular_velocity(curated_dataset_df%5Bcurated_dataset_df%5B%22Path%22%5D.str.contains(animal_ID)%5D%2Canalysis_methods%2Cinit_frame%3Dinit_frame%2Cend_frame%3Dend_frame%2Cvr_no%3D%22single%22)%0A%20%20%20%20_fig%0A%20%20%20%20return%20end_frame%2C%20init_frame%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23Session%205%3A%20Other%20metrics%20to%20study%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Session%205.1%3A%20calculating%20animal's%20speed%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%23%20We%20can%20calculate%20the%20animal's%20speed%20by%20getting%20how%20far%20they%20move%20every%20frame%20(in%20euclidean%20distance)%20and%20then%20divided%20the%20time%20difference%20between%20each%20frame%20(or%20multipled%20by%20the%20camera%20acqusition%20rate)%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(np)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20def%20euclidean_distance(X%2CY)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20return%20np.sqrt(np.add(np.square(np.diff(X))%2C%20np.square(np.diff(Y))))%0A%0A%20%20%20%20return%20(euclidean_distance%2C)%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(camera_fps%2C%20euclidean_distance%2C%20x_all%2C%20y_all)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20_travel_distance_fbf%20%3D%20euclidean_distance(x_all%2Cy_all)%0A%20%20%20%20speed%3D_travel_distance_fbf*camera_fps%0A%20%20%20%20print(speed)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Session%205.2%3A%20calculating%20optomotor%20index%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%23%20Here%2C%20we%20can%20define%20an%20index%20to%20quantify%20optomotor%20walking%20behaviour%20as%20the%20net%20angular%20velocities%20(clockwises%20and%20clockwise)%20for%20a%20given%20trial%2C%20normalised%20by%20the%20sum%20of%20the%20absolute%20value%20of%20the%20angular%20velocities.%20This%20index%20gives%20you%20an%20easy%20way%20to%20check%20how%20well%20the%20animal%20respond%20to%20rotational%20cues%20(at%20the%20cost%20of%20losing%20details%20of%20the%20turning%20behaviour%20because%20all%20the%20data%20is%20compressed%20into%20a%20single%20value).%0A%20%20%20%20For%20details%2C%20please%20refer%20to%20%5BSayin%20et%20al.%202025%5D(https%3A%2F%2Fwww.science.org%2Fdoi%2F10.1126%2Fscience.adq7832)%2C%20and%20%5BSeelig%20et%20al.%2C%202010%5D(https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nature.com%2Farticles%2Fnmeth.1468).%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(np)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20def%20optomotor_response_idx(ev_dat)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20opt_idx%20%3D%20(%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20np.nansum(abs(ev_dat%5Bev_dat%20%3E%200%5D))%20-%20np.nansum(abs(ev_dat%5Bev_dat%20%3C%200%5D))%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20)%20%2F%20(np.nansum(abs(ev_dat%5Bev_dat%20%3C%200%5D))%20%2B%20np.nansum(abs(ev_dat%5Bev_dat%20%3E%200%5D)))%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20return%20opt_idx%0A%0A%20%20%20%20return%20(optomotor_response_idx%2C)%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell%0Adef%20_(angular_velocity_tbt%2C%20end_frame%2C%20init_frame%2C%20optomotor_response_idx)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%23calculate%20optomotor%20index%3A%20You%20need%20to%20specify%20from%20which%20frame%20to%20which%20frame%20and%20at%20trial%20to%20calculate%20the%20optomotor%20index.%20The%20example%20here%20shows%20you%20the%20calculation%20of%20optomotor%20index%20at%20the%20first%20trial%2C%20from%20the%20start%20of%20the%20stimulation%20presenta
